meta.title: High School Finance, Business & Investing Opportunities
meta.description: A researched database of competitions, internships, programs and resources for high school students interested in finance, business, economics and investing.
meta.disclaimer: Deadlines and eligibility change every year. Always confirm on the official site before you rely on anything here.

ratingScales.effort: Total time and work required. 1 = an afternoon. 10 = a months-long research project.
ratingScales.competitiveness: How hard it is to place or win. 1 = everyone entering is recognized. 10 = single-digit selection rates.
ratingScales.skills: Technical floor to be competitive. 1 = no background needed. 10 = advanced math, modeling or economics.
ratingScales.prestige: How much weight this carries with colleges and employers.
ratingScales.clubFit: How well it works as a group activity. 10 = whole club participates. 1 = solo pursuit.
ratingScales.accessibility: How easy it is to get in and start. Low = costly, invite-only, or restrictive eligibility.
